tooltip.trippycraft.phenethylamine_base: Brew with Distilled Solvent (distilled ethanol) to produce Dimethoxy Intermediate.
tooltip.trippycraft.dimethoxy_intermedia: Convert to 2C-B Freebase at the Chemistry Table, or brew with Aminoethyl Reagent to obtain 2C-E Precursor.
tooltip.trippycraft.two_cb_freebase: Heat in a Furnace, Blast Furnace, Smoker, or Campfire to produce a 5000mg crystal.
tooltip.trippycraft.two_cb_powder: 100mg per powder. Package with Sugar at the Advanced Chemistry Table.
tooltip.trippycraft.two_cb_crystal_use: Right-click to consume %s mg. Grind remaining contents into 100mg powders.
tooltip.trippycraft.aminoethyl_reagent: Tryptamine Base refined from Acacia Bark. Brew with Ethanol for MET Intermediate.
tooltip.trippycraft.met_intermediate: Refine at the Chemistry Table to produce 4-HO-MET Freebase.
tooltip.trippycraft.four_ho_met_freebase: Heat in a Furnace, Blast Furnace, Smoker, or Campfire to produce a 5000mg crystal.
tooltip.trippycraft.four_ho_met_powder: 100mg per powder. Right-click to consume one in a single hit, or package with Glass Bottles at the Advanced Chemistry Table.
tooltip.trippycraft.four_ho_met_crystal_: Right-click to consume %s mg. Grind remaining contents into 100mg powders.
tooltip.trippycraft.four_ho_met_stacks: Deepens one spatial trip: breathing blocks, crystalline surfaces, and lingering motion echoes.
tooltip.trippycraft.al_lad_gameplay_mg: Contains %s AL-LAD. Effect strength follows this format's established gameplay tier.
tooltip.trippycraft.allyl_lysergic_inter: Fictional AL-LAD crafting intermediate. Refine at a Chemistry Table into AL-LAD Concentrate.
tooltip.trippycraft.al_lad_concentrate_r: Contains %s / %s mg AL-LAD for drinking or blotter production.
tooltip.trippycraft.al_lad_concentrate_u: Right-click consumes %s mg. One Blotter Sheet distributes the same amount at an Advanced Chemistry Table.
tooltip.trippycraft.al_lad_stacks: Rebuilds one stained-glass trip: moving panes, prismatic depth, and nested cathedral windows.
tooltip.trippycraft.two_ce_stacks: Locks one machine-geometry trip: nested cavities, recursive architecture, and corridor depth.
tooltip.trippycraft.nitrous_gameplay_hit: Gameplay label: one short nitrous rush
tooltip.trippycraft.nitrous_stacks: A few bright seconds: tunnel vision, white-blue haze, and time-echo trails. Another canister joins the same rush.
tooltip.trippycraft.mescaline_cactus: Craft 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 cacti in separate slots into 25mg / 100mg / 250mg / 500mg Mescaline.
tooltip.trippycraft.mescaline_stacks: Stacks without an effect ceiling; fictional game balance, not real-world guidance.
tooltip.trippycraft.ketamine_single_use: Consumed in one use for a full 1000mg ketamine effect and leaves a glass bottle behind.
tooltip.trippycraft.cannabis_stacks: Each hit adds cannabis load and lowers durability until the item is spent.
tooltip.trippycraft.cannabis_chocolate_s: Each half adds cannabis load and removes half the bar until it is spent.
tooltip.trippycraft.cannabis_gummies_sta: Each half adds cannabis load and removes half the gummy until it is spent.
tooltip.trippycraft.cannabis_edible_stac: Each gummy stacks into the active cannabis load; not real-world guidance.
tooltip.trippycraft.ethanol: A powerful solvent bottle that can also be consumed in two halves.
tooltip.trippycraft.ethanol_half_drinks: Each half adds 10 fictional standard-drink units.
tooltip.trippycraft.ethanol_total_drinks: Full bottle total: 20 fictional standard-drink units.
tooltip.trippycraft.distilled_solvent: A cleaned solvent kept in glass for finer extraction work.
tooltip.trippycraft.medicinal_reagent: A pale bottled reagent prepared from layered solvents for later formulations.
tooltip.trippycraft.aromatic_extract: Brewed from bundled plant extract and ethanol. Select MDMA or 2C-B at the Chemistry Table.
tooltip.trippycraft.refined_aromatic_oil: A concentrated aromatic oil refined with Chemistry Table heat.
tooltip.trippycraft.crude_empathogen_bas: A fictional bottled empathogen base awaiting frost-salt crystallization.
tooltip.trippycraft.mdma_crystal_use: Right-click consumes one crystal's entire remaining charge.
tooltip.trippycraft.ketamine_precursor: A suspended bottled precursor waiting for the next ketamine refinement step.
tooltip.trippycraft.fresh_salvia_leaf: Dry on a furnace, smoker, or campfire before crafting an extract.
tooltip.trippycraft.salvia_load_bong: Craft with an empty bong to load one hit.
tooltip.trippycraft.dried_cannabis_bud: Gameplay label: 200mg THC. Craft with an empty Bong for one hit, or roll a Joint.
tooltip.trippycraft.bong_empty: Empty bowl. Craft with one Dried Cannabis Bud or salvia extract to load it.
tooltip.trippycraft.bong_loaded: One hit loaded. Right-click to smoke; the empty bong is retained.
tooltip.trippycraft.cannabis_bong_stacks: One dried bud adds 200mg THC to the active cannabis load, then empties the bowl.
tooltip.trippycraft.salvia_stacks: Stacks into the active salvia state; not real-world guidance.
tooltip.trippycraft.alcohol_stacks: Stacks into the active alcohol load; not real-world guidance.
tooltip.trippycraft.blend_capsule_stacks: Releases every stored fictional dose together; not real-world guidance.

trippycraft.configuration.dmtFractalWorl: Enable the optional 3D fractal realm during DMT experiences.
trippycraft.configuration.dmtFractalQual: 0: Low (72 primary steps), 1: Balanced (112 primary steps), 2: High (192 primary steps). All levels recover unresolved surfaces. Dose-driven complexity continues to increase; quality controls rendering cost.
